facts.text: Raw signal injection feeds simulated or recorded sensor data into sensor electronics at a defined electrical point, testing everything downstream of that point but nothing upstream.
facts.quote: Raw signal injection feeds simulated or recorded sensor data into the sensor's electronics at a defined electrical point, so that everything downstream of that point is tested and everything upstream is not.

facts.text: Camera raw-image injection uses an injection device connected to the camera link to send frames directly rather than presenting a picture to the camera.
facts.quote: Instead of showing the camera a picture, an injection device plugs into the link and sends the frames directly.

facts.text: The booklet treats raw signal injection as a method in its own right because its value depends entirely on the insertion point.
facts.quote: The booklet treats this as a method in its own right because "its value depends entirely on the insertion point" [Chapter 7].

facts.text: Camera signal injection after the imager tests the processing chain, bandwidth, timing, and handling of corrupted frames and interface faults.
facts.quote: Inject after the imager and you test the processing chain, bandwidth, timing, the handling of corrupted frames and interface faults

facts.text: Camera signal injection after the imager does not test the lens, exposure control, dirt on the glass, vibration or sun glare.
facts.quote: you do not test the lens, exposure control, dirt on the glass, vibration or sun glare.

facts.text: Injecting a radar object list onto the vehicle network tests only the decision software.
facts.quote: Inject a radar object list onto the vehicle network and you test only the decision software.

facts.text: Re-injecting recorded frames into the image electronic control unit (ECU) tests everything downstream of that point, but does not retest the original lens, exposure control, imager, lens contamination, vibration or sun-glare response.
facts.quote: "tests everything downstream of that point, but it does not retest the old lens, exposure control, imager, lens contamination, vibration or sun-glare response" [Chapter 7]

facts.text: Camera raw-image injection is commercially implemented.
facts.quote: Camera raw-image injection is commercially implemented

facts.text: One vendor argues that camera raw-image injection avoids the screen-synchronization and field-of-view problems of showing a camera a monitor.
facts.quote: one vendor argues that it avoids the screen-synchronization and field-of-view problems of showing a camera a monitor [Chapter 7].

facts.text: Raw signal injection enables high-volume hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing and replay.
facts.quote: Injection makes high-volume HIL and replay possible

facts.text: The booklet insists that every injection test result state the injection boundary, so processing-chain evidence is not mistaken for evidence about sensor performance in dust or glare.
facts.quote: the booklet insists that the injection boundary be stated with every result, so that evidence about the processing chain is never mistaken for evidence about the sensor in dust or glare [Chapter 7].
